top3_caveats.statement: ibm_kingston (Heron r2) IS the source of the SC tau_2 reference (100us primary), so 'matched substrate' is structurally true. BUT: v3 cannot test cross-substrate (ion vs SC) in a single shot. The Penrose-Hameroff Orch-OR prediction was originally formulated for biological neuronal microtubules; an SC-only test establishes a textbook-QM baseline (expected NULL) but does NOT directly falsify Orch-OR at its predicted scale. Cross-substrate ion test is deferred to F-N12-1-cross (Quantinuum H-series, separate budget).
top3_caveats.match_y_n: Y for SC baseline, N for Orch-OR cross-substrate falsification

top3_caveats.statement: IBM Quantum Open Plan queues are typically 1-60 min but can stretch to 24h during peak demand or device maintenance. submit_ibm.py uses blocking job.result(); user should be prepared to leave terminal open or run in tmux/screen. Mitigation: ibm_kingston was specifically promoted into Open Plan rotation 2026-03-16, so contention should be moderate.
top3_caveats.mitigation: Submit overnight; consider service.least_busy() fallback already implemented in submit_ibm.py.

top3_caveats.statement: WebSearch confirms KQC partnership active and no US export restriction on Open Plan cloud access. However, account creation flow may show region-specific UI variations. If signup form rejects KR address, user can use any valid address (cloud account does not require physical co-location with hardware).
top3_caveats.verified_y_n: Y (open in principle; minor UI risk only)

additional_minor_caveats: qiskit-ibm-runtime had a 2024 issue (#1613) about delay+SamplerV2; verified CLOSED 2024-04-19 as user-error (bare circuit not in list). Current scripts pass list-of-circuits to sampler.run(). No regression risk.
submit_ibm.py uses channel='ibm_quantum_platform' (the unified post-2024 channel). If user has legacy 'ibm_quantum' channel token, they should regenerate via the new platform.
PAYG fallback at hard cap $5 = ~3 sec compute = insufficient for full 5-point sweep. Verifier will report INDETERMINATE if Open Plan exhausted; recommendation = wait for next 28-day window.
execution_authorization_required: User must create IBM Quantum account (mission constraint forbids agent-side signup)
User must paste API token to ~/.qiskit/ibm-quantum-token.txt
User must run launch.sh (mission constraint = $0 budget, NO actual job submission by agent)
